# folk | Core Use Cases

| Use case | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Founder and Advisor Relationship Management | Verify that Founder and Consultant Relationship Management really reduces manual maintenance with “List or Interactive Entry — Forming Clients and Opportunities - Advancing Phase - Triggering Next Step — Managing Reviews” as the main link. It is recommended to record the data completion rate, first response time, overdue follow-up, phase stay, AI recommendation adoption rate, and cost per active user. |
| Partner/Media Relations | Verify that partner/media relationships are truly reducing manual maintenance with “List or Interactive Entry — Forming Customers and Opportunities - Advancing Phase - Triggering Next Step — Managing Reviews” as the primary link. It is recommended to record the data completion rate, first response time, overdue follow-up, phase stay, AI recommendation adoption rate, and cost per active user. |
| Lightweight recruitment pipeline | Verify that the lightweight recruitment pipeline really reduces manual maintenance with the “List or Interactive Entry — Forming Customers and Opportunities - Advancing Phase - Triggering Next Step — Managing Reviews” as the main link. It is recommended to record the data completion rate, first response time, overdue follow-up, phase stay, AI recommendation adoption rate, and cost per active user. |
| Small Sales Team Email Sequence | The main link, “List or interactive entry - customer formation and business opportunities - push phase” - triggers the next step - manage the double disk, to verify whether the mail sequence of small sales teams really reduces manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
